prompt:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: production-ready transparent PNG skin background for the Tigirl Windows IME.
Input 1 is the approved visual-direction reference, not a poster to reproduce. Create ONLY the horizontal skin component as a single finished image, preserving the reference's character identity, clothing, palette and decorative theme.
Character: the same cute orange-haired tiger girl, amber eyes, fluffy tiger ears and striped tail, mint green jacket, grapefruit-slice hair clip, holding an orange grapefruit soda cup with a green straw; cheerful playful expression.
Palette: coral grapefruit pink, pale citrus yellow, mint green, warm opaque cream panel, clean dark desaturated teal outlines. Decorations: large grapefruit wedges, two or three broad green leaves, a few large clear soda bubbles.
Composition: ONE wide landscape transparent production asset, 2:1 canvas. Full skin occupies almost all canvas with a 3% outer transparent safety margin. Plain rounded rectangular candidate panel spans x=5%..95%, y=46%..90%. The LARGE girl is a half-body leaning on the top RIGHT rim, from x=56%..93%, y=5%..52%; keep her entire head, ears, cup/mooncake, forearms and tail entirely to the RIGHT of x=54% and ABOVE y=57%. Her face must be large and readable when the complete asset is displayed at 350 pixels wide. Corner decorations belong only near x<18% or x>85% and y<57% or y>79%. Crucially the vertical strip x=23%..49% contains ONLY straight horizontal top and bottom frame rails and plain interior, no character or ornament. The horizontal strip y=60%..75% contains ONLY straight left/right rails and plain interior, with transparent exterior; no bubbles, fruit, leaves, clouds or character may cross this strip. These two clean strips will be compressed/stretched in software. The central writing area x=17%..82%, y=55%..79% must be flat opaque warm cream/ivory and completely empty. The panel is comfortably high for two lines of live text.
Style: polished 2D anime illustration matching the reference, pleasing substantial linework and readable color areas, simplify tiny sparkles and filigree for small display. Keep the charming expressive face and dimensional hair, do not turn it into a generic flat icon.
Technical constraints: real RGBA alpha transparency outside the frame/character/decorations, smoothly antialiased silhouette, no white matte or gray fringe. Panel interior must remain fully opaque and flat, including all writing areas. No glow, fog, drop shadow, checkerboard, artificial background texture or scattered edge noise. Keep every ear, tail, flower, fruit, moon, bubble and prop inside the canvas with a clear outer margin.
ABSOLUTELY NO text, words, numbers, sample candidates, caret, highlight pills, selection backgrounds, separators, title, color palette swatches, guides or watermark. Only ONE complete skin component, not a sheet or comparison.
